definitions.explanation: A person on a journey, especially one who travels on foot or undertakes a long, meaningful journey. More literary and evocative than the modern 旅行者, suggesting a solitary or contemplative traveler.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旅人|たびびと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やって{来|き}た→やって来る：17013_yattekuru⟧。
examples.english: A lone traveler came to the village.

examples.japanese: {旅人|たびびと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}い→迷う：02426_mayou⟧、⟦{山小屋|やまごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一夜|いちや}→一夜：08961_ichiya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あ}かした→明かす：12961_akasu⟧。
examples.english: The traveler got lost and spent the night in a mountain hut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}→松尾芭蕉：30772_matsuobashou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{旅人|たびびと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}び→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦を{巡|めぐ}って→を巡って：27595_womegutte⟧⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}んだ→詠む：14186_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Matsuo Basho called himself a traveler and composed haiku as he journeyed across the land.

notes:
USAGE:
{旅人|たびびと} has a literary and poetic quality, evoking the image of a wanderer on foot. It appears frequently in folktales, classical literature, and historical narratives. ⟦{松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}→松尾芭蕉：30772_matsuobashou⟧'s famous opening of ⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細道|ほそみち}→細道：23053_hosomichi⟧ — "⟦{月日|つきひ}→月日：04063_tsukihi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百代|はくたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過客|かかく}にして" — reflects this tradition of the poet as traveler.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{孤独|こどく}→孤独：04843_kodoku⟧な{旅人|たびびと}: a solitary traveler
- {旅人|たびびと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome a traveler
- {旅人|たびびと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: the figure of a traveler

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旅行者|りょこうしゃ}→旅行者：22927_ryokousha⟧: tourist, traveler (modern, neutral)
- {旅人|たびびと}: traveler, wanderer (literary, evocative)
- ⟦{放浪者|ほうろうしゃ}→放浪者：24917_hourousha⟧: vagabond, drifter (aimless wandering)
